description: This file contains C source code for collecting and logging process statistics such as CPU and memory usage, specifically for a service component in a watchdog system. It includes functions to gather process memory info from /proc/self/statm and CPU usage via getrusage, and defines related data structures and constants.

methods.name: collectServiceStats
methods.description: Gathers process memory and CPU usage statistics and adds them to the provided runtimeStatsPojo output.

methods.name: getMemoryProcessUsage
methods.description: Reads process memory info from /proc/self/statm and populates a procMemStats structure.
